coordination.note: HNRP (OCHA); refugee/migrant CVA is reported within the OCHA CVA snapshot (RMMS multi-sector), not a separate UNHCR plan.

cwg_reliefweb.last_update_basis: latest document posted (OCHA MPCA Snapshot July-October 2025)
cwg_reliefweb.dashboard_name: Yemen Cash and Voucher Assistance Snapshot (OCHA infographics)
cwg_reliefweb.contacts_basis: No contacts block, chairs or minutes on the page.
cwg_reliefweb.note: CMWG described as a technical advisory group. No chair/co-chair organisations or minutes shown; snapshot infographic has no dashboard link.

cva_delivered_usd.note: US$48.57M by 58 partners; a Jan-Dec 2025 infographic exists but its figures were not readable.

sectoral_cva_delivered_usd.note: Sectoral CVA (food security, protection, shelter) named but no amount stated; multisectoral CVA via RRM and RMMS.

fsps.name: YCash (National Cash Transfer Co.)
fsps.evidence: FinDev Gateway (2021) says YCash delivers ICRC cash transfers; licensed humanitarian transfers company.

fsps.name: Yemen Post (Posts and Postal Services Corporation)
fsps.evidence: WFP release reports cash transfers via the Yemeni postal corporation in Taiz and Ibb (undated, early programme).

fsps.name: Yemen Mobile, Aden Net, YOU
fsps.evidence: REACH FSP findings (Apr 2025) name these three MNOs as partnering with FSPs to activate mobile money; no humanitarian user named; communities mainly use exchange offices.
